text: ああ　コイキング…　ね　よく　つれる　けど　よわすぎるんだよなあ…

structure.jp: ああ　コイキング…　ね
よく　つれる　けど
structure.en: you catch them a lot, but

structure.jp: よわすぎるんだよなあ…
structure.en: they're just too weak, you know…

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a describing word, in place of its last い, means 'too much'. よわすぎる = 'too weak'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two statements like 'but'. よく　つれる　けど = 'you catch them a lot, but'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ, the spoken form of のだ, gives a statement the feel of explaining how things are. よわすぎるんだ = 'the thing is, they're too weak'.
